about:
Sunbelt Plastics Inc was founded in 1977 in Frisco, Texas, as an injection molding company. The business began as a specialist in custom plastic parts and has operated from its North Texas location for over four decades. The company's headquarters remain at 8940 Alpha Avenue, with a mailing address of PO Box 370, in Frisco's 75034 ZIP code.

The company provides custom plastic injection molding services, producing plastic parts to customer specifications. Details on facility size, headcount, annual volume, or part-number range are not disclosed in the available information. The core capability is injection molding of custom plastic components.

Sunbelt Plastics serves customers requiring custom molded plastic components, though specific industries or named clients are not listed in the source material. The company presents itself as a manufacturing partner for injection molding needs across a range of applications.

The company positions itself as a trusted manufacturing partner for injection molding needs, but no further stated differentiators or founding motivations are provided beyond its long-standing presence in the market.
